name: Primordial Nightmare: "The Creator"
summary: • Primordial Nightmare's Attribute Anomaly DMG taken is reduced by 30%. When switching from Miasmic Shield state to normal state, or from normal state to Miasmic Shield state, Agent CRIT DMG against them is increased by 20%. This effect can stack up to 3 times and resets when Primordial Nightmare recovers from Stun.

appearances.performance: • Triggering PURIFIED!! grants 1000 Performance Points. During the Control Skill, each successful counter against Primordial Nightmare's attacks grants 500 Performance Points. Performing a SHUTDOWN!! on Primordial Nightmare's Control Skill grants 2000 Performance Points, up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points.
appearances.misc: • Suitable for Agents with Attack specialty.
